observations.explanation: The paper describes four configurable task categories, including multi-hop tracing and aggregation, beyond retrieval (PDF pp. 1, 3).
The authors report evaluating each task with 500 generated examples at each of six context lengths, using vLLM, BF16 on eight A100 GPUs, and greedy decoding (PDF p. 6).

Effective length is explicitly defined by comparison with the Llama2-7B score at 4K, which the paper calls a fixed threshold for satisfactory performance; it is not presented as a universal adequacy standard (PDF p. 6).

The paper explicitly calls common/frequent word extraction a proxy for summarization and describes these as synthetic word-list tasks, so their results do not directly establish performance on realistic summarization (PDF p. 5).
